name: Government organization classification
description: What kind of body this is. It follows two existing standards: Popolo and the W3C Organization Ontology.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Government
hasDefinedTerm.description: The whole-of-government body at the top of an organization tree, such as a city, county, state or national government. It has no parent. Its legislature, executive and departments sit beneath it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Legislature
hasDefinedTerm.description: An elected group that debates and decides: a council, assembly, parliament, or board of supervisors.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Executive
hasDefinedTerm.description: The head of government's own office: the mayor's office, a cabinet, or a city manager's office.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Department
hasDefinedTerm.description: A unit that delivers services under the executive.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Agency
hasDefinedTerm.description: A body with power the executive has handed off, often at arm's length from it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Committee
hasDefinedTerm.description: A smaller group inside a legislature or board, usually focused on one subject.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Commission
hasDefinedTerm.description: An appointed body that reviews, advises, or acts like a court on specific matters.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Office
hasDefinedTerm.description: An office held by one person, like an auditor or ombudsman.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Public enterprise
hasDefinedTerm.description: A business the government owns, like a utility, transit operator, or port authority.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Division
hasDefinedTerm.description: A unit inside a department or agency, below the level that answers to the executive.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Bureau
hasDefinedTerm.description: A unit inside a department or agency. Governments use bureau, division and section differently; pick the one that matches how the government itself describes the unit.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Authority
hasDefinedTerm.description: A body created by statute to run a function with its own governing board and often its own revenue, such as a housing, transit or water authority.
